description: CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, dbVersion120). The inner-index tables KA (primary key) and KB (no index), KG and KH (neither indexed): SELECT t, u FROM KA LEFT JOIN KB ON KA.k = KB.k, KB LEFT JOIN KA, KA RIGHT JOIN KB, KB RIGHT JOIN KA, and the same four over KG and KH. Asks whether the preserved side always drives, and in which order, with and without an index on the other side.
